limitations: Real first-order derivative energy; unnormalized arclength mean; standard Kirchhoff conditions; equal unit-length rail edges and one common strictly positive rung length. No assertion for nonuniform rungs, variable rails, nonuniform density, higher derivatives, or alternative coupling.
scientific_integrity: A self-contained analytical proof derives the continuous mean-zero Green diagonal from the weighted prism Laplacian. Separately formulated exact-rational Poisson checks corroborate 60 finite test evaluations, but these do not certify all parameters. Priority assessment is literature-limited; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: A golden-ratio edge-localization threshold on weighted metric prisms
